purpose_detail: Baseline straight route of CN60-1100-1:18 from the local turnout DB. Right rail carries two extra bodies so the design lowering (blade 14.94 mm, point rail 13.70 mm) is section geometry, and every station cancels its own crown y so the pair is symmetric by construction. Diverging route: the right line rides y = (s-50.578)^2/(2*1100.75) and the run carries curve_radius_m so the body force exists.
parameter_source: Simpack text model CRH380A_M_{Carbody,Bogie,Wheelset}.spck subvariables (masses, inertias, suspension stiffness/damping, rail geometry, contact material and friction); rail geometry read-only from diagnostics/crh380a_m_track_catalog.json

declared_model_limits: rigid track: no rail mass, support stiffness or fastener compliance
single equivalent rail per side per axle: no stock/switch/wing sub-rail split
hertz_effective_radius normal law is a reduced-order substitute, not Simpack RWP
no axlebox bodies (Simpack has four 48.2 kg axle guides on stiff joints)
primary yaw stiffness is not exposed by the .spck; taken from Par_Vehicle_CRH380A_v6.m
